title: Pavard is hurt too, and Inter play at Bologna today
description: Cristian Chivu says Lautaro Martínez should be back after the November break, and two Under-23 players travel to the Dall'Ara.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 46, Saturday, October 17, 2026 — Pavard is hurt too, and Inter play at Bologna today

blocks.html: Inter said on Friday that Benjamin Pavard, a center back, has a strain in his right adductors. He is the second player ruled out this week, after Lautaro Martínez, and Inter play at Bologna today at 12:00 PM ET, 18:00 CEST. Cristian Chivu, Inter’s head coach, said his captain will probably be back after the November break, and asked his players for a reaction.

blocks.h3: Chivu says Lautaro Martínez returns after the break
paras: Cristian Chivu, Inter's head coach, spoke at Appiano Gentile, Inter's training ground, on Friday. The club headlined his answers "Dobbiamo reagire, consapevoli della nostra forza" — we have to react, aware of our own strength.

On Lautaro Martínez, the captain and center forward who strained his left hamstring this week, Chivu said the striker will be out for a while. He added that "probabilmente tornerà dopo la sosta" — he will probably be back after the November break. Yesterday's five-to-six-week estimate came from Gazzetta dello Sport, Italy's biggest sports daily; this one is the coach's own.
Chivu asked for more running and clearer communication rather than a revolution. On Ange-Yoan Bonny, a center forward, he said: "Ange mi sta impressionando" — Ange is impressing me.

blocks.h3: Pavard has a strain in his right adductors
paras: Inter said on Friday that Benjamin Pavard, a center back, had clinical and diagnostic tests that morning at the Istituto Humanitas hospital in Rozzano, outside Milan. The tests, the club said, showed "un risentimento agli adduttori della coscia destra" — a strain in the adductor muscles of his right thigh.
The statement gave no return date.

blocks.h3: The Under-23 side play today, the women on Sunday
paras: Inter's Under-23 team host Monopoli at the Stadio Ernesto Breda in Sesto San Giovanni today at 8:30 AM ET, 14:30 CEST, in Serie C matchday 10. They are seventh, with one game in hand, after winning 4–0 at Giugliano.
Inter Women host Parma at the Arena Civica Gianni Brera in Milan on Sunday at 12:00 PM ET, 18:00 CEST, in Serie A Women matchday 3. Entry is free, and Inter have won both openers 2–0.

blocks.h3: The papers still disagree over who starts beside Thuram
paras: Sky Sport Italia's projected lineup, published Friday, puts Francesco Pio Esposito, a center forward, beside Marcus Thuram, with Ange-Yoan Bonny on the bench. Gazzetta dello Sport, relayed by FCInter1908, had it the other way on Thursday: Bonny favored, Esposito waiting.
Inter have published no lineup, and the two projections have been trading places all week — a fair measure of how open the call is.
blocks.kicker: UPDATE · SKY SPORT ITALIA AND GAZZETTA DELLO SPORT · OCT 16

blocks.h3: FCInterNews expects Pavard out at least 20 days
paras: FCInterNews, an Inter news site, wrote on Friday that Pavard faces "uno stop di almeno 20 giorni" — a layoff of at least 20 days. Inter have published no timeline of their own.
The same site says two Under-23 players travel with the squad: Leonardo Bovio, a defender, and Mattia Mosconi, a forward.
